If you're referring to the **Treaty of Cahuenga** (most geographically relevant to Los Angeles), it was signed on **September 16, 1847**. If you're thinking of the **Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo**, it was signed on **February 2, 1848**. Both are legitimate historical treaties, though neither is formally called the "Treaty of Los Angeles."
